info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Route Lookup API enables users to efficiently access detailed information about available rideshare routes. This API provides critical data on routes used by various rideshare services, facilitating improved planning and optimization for drivers and riders alike. Typical consumers include rideshare app developers, logistics companies, and urban planners looking to enhance transportation solutions. Utilize this API to streamline route finding and enhance user experience within rideshare applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the optimal route for rides.
get.description: This endpoint is used to obtain the best route for a ride, taking into consideration various factors such as traffic, distance, and current road conditions. It provides essential data to improve the efficiency of ride-hailing services.
